response.overview: The film tells the story of the Viking Age and a young woman named Skuld. she possesses magical abilities and the power to foresee and influence the future using the threads of fate. In a Viking settlement, while working at the forge, a blacksmith named Olaf sees a flash of lightning, followed by the roar of thunder and the cry of a child. Taking a torch, he ventures into the forest, where he finds a cradle containing a baby girl. Inside the cradle, a glowing ball of yarn lies beside a tablet inscribed with the name "Skuld." Hearing the howling of wolves nearby, Olaf decides to take the child and raise her as his own daughter.
response.tagline: One thread to bind, one blade to cleave. Fate is not written; it is woven.
response.title: Skuld
